reason: Customers fighting me over which part was changed costs me more than a few thousand rupees a month, and if the boys only have to press one button and talk in Tamil, I can try it free with someone setting it up in my office. I will put it on 5 or 6 technicians first, not all 40, and see if they actually do it.
objection: My technicians will not use an app; they barely read English. If they forget to press the button or the Tamil comes out wrong in the report, the customer gets a wrong report on WhatsApp and the dispute becomes worse, not better.
would_change_my_mind: If after two weeks most of the technicians stop using it and my coordinator is still chasing them on WhatsApp for photos and updates, I will drop it.
